strategy.thesis: Seed-stage all-sector VC covering pre-seed, seed, 'post-seed' (the gap to Series A) and pre-Series-A; first checks ¥30–200M with follow-on up to ¥1bn, expanding into university-derived deep tech.

summary.en: Partners Fund (formerly Full Commit Partners, founded 2018; current entity Aug 2024) is a seed-stage all-sector VC. Its 2nd fund targets ¥6.5bn (first close April 2025); first checks ¥30–200M, follow-on up to ¥1bn.
summary.local: Partners Fund(旧Full Commit Partners、2018年創業/現法人2024年8月)はオールジャンルのシード特化VC。2号は総額65億円規模目標(2025年4月ファーストクローズ)。初回30〜200百万円、追加最大10億円。
